title: feat(console): report index groups reports by object, with All/Recent views and search
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_

Fixes #27526

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：应用的报表索引页从一张平铺列表改为按报表主对象分组（导航顺序，「其它」垫底，组头带计数可折叠），顶部加「全部 / 最近」两个视图（按用户记住选择）和搜索框；每行显示报表名、所属对象、上次打开时间。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决「索引页按对象分组 + 最近/我的/全部」；报表多了以后平铺列表找不到东西。「我创建的」和行内「所有者」按维护者裁决 B 不做（服务端下发的报表没有创建者；所有权随 North Star 报表那一行再做）。
- 风险与回滚：只动 Console 的索引页和十个语言包，不动 spec、不动服务端、不加元数据键；回滚即 revert 本 PR。视图偏好存在浏览器 localStorage 的 `os:pref:reports.index.view`。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/appReportIndex.ts`（主对象推导 `reportPrimaryObject`、分组 `groupReportsByObject`、偏好声明）→ `AppReportIndexView.tsx`（视图与搜索）→ 新测试 `AppReportIndex.groupsViews-27526.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.groupsViews-27526.test.tsx`，预期 17/17 通过。
- 需要你做的：无。裁决 B 已记在卡上（6509006168），席位 ACCEPT 后落地。

## What changes

The app's report index (`/apps/APP/reports`, `AppReportIndexView`) listed every report the member may open as one flat list. It now follows the card's Target 1–3, except the 「我创建的」 view and the row's owner, which the maintainer's ruling B dropped from the card (see Acceptance notes).

- **Grouped by primary object, derived, no new key.** `reportPrimaryObject` in `appReportIndex.ts` takes the object of the first dataset the report binds, in `reportDatasets` order (its own `dataset`, then each `blocks[].dataset`), that the dataset list maps to an object. Rule chosen for a report with several datasets: **the first dataset that resolves to an object**, so a joined report whose first block names an unknown dataset still lands under the object of its next block. A report with none goes to the 「其它」 section.
- **Section order.** `groupReportsByObject`: first the objects the app's served navigation names (`type: 'object'` entries, in the order `flattenNavigation` first meets them), then the objects it does not name, by label, then 「其它」. Each section header is a button with `aria-expanded` that shows the count and collapses its section (visit-only state).
- **Views.** A view switch with two buttons, **All reports** (全部) and **Recent** (最近). The choice is `REPORT_INDEX_VIEW_PREFERENCE`, declared through `defineWorkspacePreference` in the `user` scope, stored as `{"value":"all"|"recent","v":1}` under `os:pref:reports.index.view`; a reader who never chose, or whose stored value the codec does not read, sees All reports. Recent reads the recent-items store (`useRecentItems`, the `report` entries and their `visitedAt`) and lists the index's reports the reader opened, most recent first, as one flat list: the order is the point of that view, so it is not split by object (my reading of Target 1 + 2; the sections apply to All reports). A recent report the index does not list (another app's, an unreadable one) is not shown.
- **Rows.** A row is the report's link (label and description, so the link's accessible name stays the report's label, which the existing index pins rely on), its object's label and when the reader last opened it (`timeAgo` in the display locale), with the link's overlay covering the row. The object and time cells hide below `sm`.
- **Search.** A search box filters the current view by report label, description or object label, case-insensitively; a view with no match says so.
- **Object labels.** `useReportObjectLabels` labels the sections (plural) and rows (singular) from the object definitions the shell reads for the app: the app's package object scope, the same `readObjectScope` read the navigation gates already make, plus the grouped objects outside the package by name; an app with no package reads those objects by name. The index still never reads the whole object registry (the existing CONTROL pin holds, and a new one beside it).
- **i18n.** Nine new `console.reportIndex.*` keys in all ten packs: `viewsLabel`, `viewAll`, `viewRecent`, `searchPlaceholder`, `searchLabel`, `otherSection`, `lastOpened`, `recentEmpty`, `noMatch`.

The ⌘K palette reads the same `useAppReportEntries`; its entries gain an optional `object` and are otherwise unchanged.

`useReportObjectLabels` reads `getItemsByType('object')` only where the app's object scope cannot be read, so it is a reader the objectui#12811 census counts: `console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts` gains one `scope` row for `appReportIndex.ts`, the same kind as `useServedViewItems` and `useObjectPresence`.

## Why

Maintainer ruling on the card, quoted verbatim: 「ui（索引页按对象分组 + 最近/我的/全部）」. A flat list stops working once an app ships more than a handful of reports.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.groupsViews-27526.test.tsx` (17 tests), through the real `MetadataProvider`, `MePermissionsProvider`, `ExpressionProvider`, `RecentItemsProvider` and `I18nProvider`:

- grouping: sections in navigation order (Opportunity before Lead although L sorts first), an object the navigation does not name next, 「其它」 last, with counts; a joined report goes under the first of its datasets that resolves; the row's object cell; a header collapses only its own section; labels read from the package scope and never the whole registry;
- views: All reports with no stored choice; Recent lists opened reports most recent first, only the index's, with "Opened N hours ago"; the choice is written as `{"value":"recent","v":1}` and read back by a fresh mount; an unreadable stored value is no choice; Recent with nothing opened says so; no 我创建的 button;
- search: within All reports by label (empty sections dropped, counts recomputed) and by object label; within Recent only among opened reports; the no-match message.

The three existing index files (`AppReportIndex-13020`, `.navContributions-13273`, `.navGates-26892`) pass unchanged.

Run at head `82d69466` (after the latest merge of `main`):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/` plus 56 named files: the ⌘K palette, `AppContent`, `AppHeader`, sidebar and route-chunk files that read `useAppReportEntries` or the console routes, and the objectui#12811 census: Test Files 164 passed (164), Tests 1523 passed (1523). The rest of the app-shell suite is CI's `Test UI`, green on this head.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/`: Test Files 90 passed, Tests 1380 passed, 13 skipped (the packs' key-parity pins included).
- Four ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (restored and proved restored): navigation order replaced by label order, 2 tests red; primary object taken from the first dataset only, 3 red; the view held in `useState` instead of the preference, 2 red; Recent listing every report, 3 red.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ruled B: 「我创建的」 and the row's owner are dropped.** Ruling-ref: 6509006168. The maintainer ruled B on #27526 (on dev report 6500744179): both leave this card, and report ownership comes back with the North Star reports line, not here. No spec, engine or metadata-protocol change. The measurement behind the question stays on record: the served `/meta/report` item is the stored row's parsed body plus read decorations (`storedOverlayEntries` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts`); a report the signed-in admin saved through `PUT /api/v1/meta/report/NAME` on a live showcase has `sys_metadata.created_by` set, yet neither `/meta/report` nor `/meta/report/NAME` serves a creator; `ReportSchema` declares no owner key; a code-authored report (every HotCRM report) has no creator; and a code package refuses report saves (422), so a code app's index never lists a member's console-saved report. The index renders no 我创建的 control, and a test pins its absence.
- **Recent is one flat list, not grouped**, and **sections apply to All reports**: my reading of Target 1 with Target 2.
- **The primary-object rule** is the first dataset that resolves to an object, not strictly the first dataset (see What changes).
- **Last-opened time** comes from the recent-items store, which keeps the reader's last 20 targets of every kind: a report opened long ago shows no time and is not in Recent.
- **Docs.** `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 asks a feature to update the package README and its `content/docs/frontend/` page; no docs page describes the report index today and the dispatch's file surface excludes docs, so none is written here.
- **Live run.** HotCRM is outside this session's repository scope, so the run booted `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --ui --fresh`) on the built console. A code package is read-only for report saves, so four env-wide reports over the invoice, account and project datasets and a console app naming those objects were saved. Its index showed Invoices 2, Accounts 1, Projects 1, Tasks 2 in navigation order; Recent listed the two opened reports with their times; the stored choice survived a reload; search narrowed to one section. The run found the last-opened cell cutting its text, fixed in `19b7a1d9`. Screenshots are in the project thread; nothing is uploaded here.
